 Real Madrid’s expected lineup against Racing Santander 
 Santander, Spain – Real Madrid are preparing for another La Liga match when they visit Racing Santander this Sunday evening for Matchday 11 of the 2026-2027 season. The Royal Club will be looking to continue their winning streak and climb the league table.
 Real Madrid will enter the match under the leadership of their Portuguese coach, José Mourinho, with expected changes to the starting lineup. This comes after the confirmation that Uruguayan midfielder Fede Valverde will be absent from the squad, having missed today’s training session.
 Valverde’s situation and Courtois’ potential return
 Valverde suffered an injury during the Clasico against Barcelona in the last round. Despite this, he played through the pain for about 40 minutes in the match, which ended in a 2-1 victory for Real Madrid.
 On the other hand, the royal team is awaiting the return of its Belgian goalkeeper, Thibaut Courtois, to the starting lineup. Courtois had missed the match against Barcelona due to suffering from influenza, and there were expectations that he would participate against Racing Santander.
 Real Madrid and Racing Santander standings
 Real Madrid enters the match in third place in the Spanish league standings with 24 points. They aim to secure a victory to continue putting pressure on their rivals in the title race.
 On the other hand, Racing Santander will be playing at home, currently in 15th place with 11 points. They hope to capitalize on home advantage and the support of their fans to secure a positive result against one of the league’s top teams.
 Real Madrid’s expected lineup against Racing Santander
 Jose Mourinho is expected to field the following lineup against Racing Santander:
 Goalkeeper: Thibaut Courtois.
 Defense: Alvaro Carreras, Antonio Rudiger, Ibrahima Konate, Dumfries.
 Midfield: Aurélien Tchouaméni, Bernardo Silva.
 Attacking midfield: Diomande, Jude Bellingham, Arda Guler.
 Attack: Kylian Mbappe.
